name: Deflection
what: moves away from the question asked
affordance: moves away from the question asked while appearing responsive
mechanism: violates Grice's maxim of Relation while performing cooperation — the question is left standing, unanswered
benign_reading: Changing the subject can be tact, care, or discretion. The tell is a direct question steered around rather than declined openly.
ledger_line: {n} deflection{s} — the question was steered around, not answered
output_phrasing: the question asked here is steered around, not answered
